title: improv·artist · patient (Agnes Martin)
mutation_directive: improv artist: patient via Agnes Martin

improv_extras.practice: graphite grids on washed-pale canvas; restraint, breath-paced lines, near-invisibility as devotion

v1.feedback: Strong Martin translation — horizontal bands with hand-drawn wobble, edge dissolution into cream, and the orthographic camera are all correct choices. Two refinements: vary band spacing more irregularly (Martin's ruled lines had uneven gaps that gave each painting its emotional texture — here the rows are too uniformly spaced), and slow the wash drift even further (uTime * 0.03 is fine but uTime * 0.015 would better reward the 'patient' keyword, making the golden light cross the field over minutes rather than tens of seconds). The 0.35 ochre blend factor is tasteful; don't increase it.

v2.feedback: Strong Agnes Martin translation — orthographic camera, irregular ruled bands, and glacial ochre wash all map directly to her practice. To refine: vary graphite density per-band (some lines pressed harder, some barely there) so the field breathes vertically, not just horizontally; and let the golden wash sweep even more slowly (uTime * 0.008) so a full cycle takes 5+ minutes — Martin's paintings reward patience measured in minutes, not seconds. The edge dissolution is elegant but could extend inward slightly so the field feels cropped from a larger infinite grid rather than fading at a boundary.
